sections.label: Category D COE price rise
sections.summary: Category D COE prices rose from a 2001 low of $509 to $9,689 in September 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2001, the lowest COE prices for Cat D was $509 in December while highest was $1,313 in January.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Ten years on, 2011, the lowest price was in December, $1,481 and highest in March, $2,534.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This year, 2021, the COE price in January was $7,501 and it has skyrocketed in the last couple of months, to $8,899 and $9,689 for August and September, respectively.

sections.label: Rider salaries versus motorcycle COE
sections.summary: Rider salaries of $1,000 to $2,500 mean four to 10 months' pay for a motorcycle COE.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: However, browsing through the job listings for riders on the MyCareersFuture website, I noticed that the monthly salaries offered range between $1,000 and $2,500.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: That is to say, that someone who wants to purchase a Class 2B motorcycle so that he can earn an income as a dispatch rider, will need to set aside four to 10 months of a salary he has not yet earned just to afford the latest COE for a motorcycle.

sections.label: New, used or rented motorcycles
sections.summary: Buyers choose between new and second-hand motorcycles, while renting at about $70 daily is not sustainable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And again, the difficult choice has to be made between buying a new machine or a second-hand vehicle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: They can also rent motorcycles, but that is not a sustainable option in the medium to long term, given the rental rates of around $70 daily.

sections.label: Category D COE price increase
sections.summary: Category D COE prices rose from $509 in 2001 to $9,689 in September this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: COE prices for Category D have continued to rise and have skyrocketed recently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2001, the lowest price was $509 in December and the highest was recorded in January with $1,313.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Ten years later, in 2011, the lowest price was recorded in December, which was $1,481, and the highest price in March was $2,534.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This year, the price reached $7,501 in January and continued to soar to $8,899 in August and $9,689 for September.

sections.label: Unused COEs and speculation
sections.summary: Unused COEs and May price rises despite more COEs suggest speculation may exist, though LTA saw no evidence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Although LTA maintained that there is no evidence of speculation, the number of COEs that had been obtained but remain unused, as well as the increase in COE prices in May despite a higher number of COEs on offer, indicate the possibility that this problem really exists.

sections.label: PARF extension for motorcyclists
sections.summary: A speaker proposes extending PARF to motorcyclists who de-register early, as motorcycle ARF is 15% of OMV.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: First, I propose that a Preferential Additional Registration Fee (PARF) be also extended to motorcyclists who de-register their motorcycles early.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As MOT had explained previously, given that the ARF for motorcycles is only 15% of its Open Market Value (OMV), the amount of PARF that motorcyclists can receive is not high enough to incentivise them to de-register their motorcycles.

sections.label: Motorcycle parking for dispatch workers
sections.summary: Allocated motorcycle parking lots for dispatch workers in such areas can help them perform duties without compromising public safety, save delivery time and enhance work routine and life circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: By setting up allocated motorcycle parking lots for dispatch workers in such areas, it can help them perform their duties without compromising public safety, save delivery time and, at the same, enhance their work routine and their life circumstances.

sections.label: TCOE utilisation rates
sections.summary: Since COE bidding resumed in July 2020, utilised TCOEs have been about 99%, above the historical average of about 91%, including 99.7% for TCOEs expiring end September 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Since COE bidding resumed in July 2020, the proportion of utilised TCOEs has been high at approximately 99% as compared to the historical average of about 91%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: This remains the case even for the TCOEs that just expired at the end of September 2021 where the utilisation rate was 99.7%.

sections.label: COE supply and premiums
sections.summary: The additional quota return was completed with the second July 2021 bidding exercise, and August to October 2021 COE supply is 28% lower than May to July 2021, with increased demand and lower supply likely contributing to higher premiums since August.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: This return of the additional quota was completed with the second bidding exercise in July 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: So, for the current August to October 2021 period, the COE supply is 28% lower than the preceding quarter, May to July 2021 period, with the supply being predominantly determined by deregistration.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: So, this combination of increased demand and the lower COE supply would likely have contributed to the higher premiums in the bidding exercises since August but has receded somewhat in the most recent bidding exercise.

sections.label: Removal of option consequences
sections.summary: Removing this option could have unintended consequences for buyers and will have to be studied carefully.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The removal of this option could have unintended consequences for buyers and will have to be studied carefully.

sections.label: Motorcycle ARF, PARF and road tax
sections.summary: Motorcycles pay lower ARF at 15% of OMV versus 100% for cars, there are no plans to extend the PARF scheme to other vehicle types, and six-monthly road tax is $31 for Class 2B motorcycles versus $156 for cars under 600 cc.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Motorcycles pay significantly lower ARF with a base rate of 15% of the vehicle's OMV, compared to 100% for car.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: We do not have plans to extend the PARF scheme to other vehicle types.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The six-monthly road tax amount is $31 for Class 2B motorcycles as compared to $156 for cars of engine capacity less than 600 cc.

sections.label: Commercial building motorcycle parking
sections.summary: Commercial building owners are strongly encouraged to set aside motorcycle parking lots for food delivery riders and provide a reasonable parking grace period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Commercial building owners are strongly encouraged to set aside motorcycle parking lots for food delivery riders and to provide a reasonable parking grace period for them.
